NORTH AMERICA

🇺🇸 United States – U.S. and Nigerian forces reportedly killed a senior Islamic State leader during a joint operation in Nigeria’s Lake Chad Basin region.

🇺🇸 United States – Pentagon canceled a planned long-range missile battalion deployment to Germany, triggering congressional backlash over NATO force posture concerns.

🇺🇸 United States – FBI announced a $200,000 reward for a former U.S. Air Force counterintelligence agent accused of providing national defense information to Iran.

🇺🇸 United States – Two military jets collided during an Idaho air show; all four crew members successfully ejected before impact.

🇺🇸 United States – Army leaders faced congressional scrutiny following abrupt cancellation of a 4,000-soldier deployment to Poland.

EUROPE

🇷🇺 Russia – Ukrainian forces launched more than 500 drones in one of the largest overnight attacks of the war, causing fatalities in the Moscow region.

🇱🇹 Lithuania – Authorities discovered a suspected Ukrainian military drone after it crashed inside Lithuanian territory, increasing Baltic concerns over airspace spillover.

🇱🇻 Latvia – NATO forces conducted robotic ground combat exercises near the Russian border amid expanding unmanned warfare preparations.

🇱🇻 Latvia – Canada-led NATO brigade in Latvia announced transition from “tripwire” deterrence posture toward a more robust territorial defense mission.

MIDDLE EAST

🇮🇱 Israel – Israeli forces launched major airstrikes across southern Lebanon despite the extension of the Israel-Hizbollah ceasefire framework.

🇵🇸 Gaza Strip – Israel stated it killed the leader of Hamas’ military wing, identified as one of the final surviving planners of the 7 October attacks.

🇮🇷 Iran – Iranian leadership intensified public warnings regarding readiness for renewed conflict as nuclear and ceasefire negotiations with Washington stalled.

🇦🇪 United Arab Emirates – A drone strike ignited a fire near the Barakah nuclear facility, highlighting escalating regional drone warfare risks during the fragile U.S.–Iran ceasefire.

🇹🇼 Taiwan – Trump’s comments describing Taiwan as a “good negotiating chip” with China triggered heightened concern in Taipei over U.S. strategic reliability.

AFRICA

🇳🇬 Nigeria – Joint U.S.–Nigerian counterterrorism forces eliminated a senior Islamic State commander during a precision operation in the Lake Chad Basin.

🇸🇩 Sudan – Expanding drone warfare between Sudanese military forces and the Rapid Support Forces is driving increased civilian casualties and infrastructure damage.

ASIA-PACIFIC

🇵🇭 Philippines – U.S. Marines conducted dispersed island-seizure operations during Exercise Balikatan 2026, operating simultaneously across 17 Philippine locations.

🇰🇷 South Korea – Analysts warned Seoul’s planned 500,000-drone force risks becoming unsustainable without sufficient logistics and industrial support.

CYBER, SPACE & DEFENSE INDUSTRY

🇺🇸 United States – The Army ordered rifle-mounted smart scopes designed to improve infantry capability against small drone threats.

🇺🇸 United States – Pentagon signed agreements targeting rapid procurement of at least 10,000 low-cost cruise missiles within three years.

🇺🇸 United States – Anduril secured a major Army contract to produce thousands of Barracuda-500M cruise missiles beginning in 2027.

ANG UNANG dApp AY OPISYAL AT MATAGUMPAY NANG NAILUNSAD SA INTERLINK TAJ MAHAL TESTNET. 🔥

Hindi ito demo. Hindi ito prototype. Isa itong totoong application na tumatakbo sa tunay na infrastructure ng InterLink Chain Taj Mahal Testnet ngayon mismo.

Ipinapakilala ang BitFlip, isang Bitcoin price prediction game na fully on-chain at pinapagana ng InterLink Chain.

Sa bawat round, nire-record ng chain ang live BTC price. Huhulaan ng mga manlalaro kung tataas o bababa ang presyo ng Bitcoin pagkalipas ng 5 minuto, kung saan 3 minuto ang bukas para sa pagtaya at 2 minuto ang lock period bago ang settlement. Ang minimum stake ay 0.01 $ITL at maximum na 10 $ITL. Kapag tama ang prediction mo, mababawi mo ang stake mo kasama ang 90% reward. Kapag mali, mawawala ang stake. Walang off-chain middleware, walang centralized resolver, at walang manual intervention. Lahat ng rounds ay direktang nagbubukas, nagla-lock, at nagsesettle sa InterLink Chain.

Para gumana nang maayos ang BitFlip, kailangang tunay ang infrastructure. Kinailangan ng RPC layer na kayanin ang live round creation, bet submission, at on-chain settlement nang tuloy-tuloy sa loob ng 5-minute window, kahit may totoong user load, habang deterministic pa rin ang resulta sa bawat pagkakataon. Walang lag, walang ambiguity, walang puwang para sa error. At nagawa ito nang maayos.

Ang BitFlip ay patunay na ang RPC infrastructure ng InterLink Chain ay hindi na lamang teorya. Nakakonekta ang mga developer, napoproseso ang mga transaksyon, nasesettle ang rounds, at tuloy-tuloy na nakakapaglaro ang mga users nang walang kahit isang system interruption. Gumana ang lahat ayon sa eksaktong inaasahan.

At ang ipinapakita ng testnet phase na ito ay higit pa sa isang laro. Ang InterLink Chain ay isang app-chain model. Ang mga developer dito ay hindi limitado sa pagde-deploy ng smart contracts sa ilalim ng rules ng ibang network. Maaaring bumuo ang mga team ng application-specific blockchains na may buong kontrol sa sarili nilang fee structure, tokenomics, validator sets, at governance design. Bawat application ay may dedicated blockspace nang hindi nakikipagkumpitensya sa gas fees laban sa ibang traffic. Ang sovereignty dito ay hindi premium feature — ito ang pundasyon.

Ganito ang resulta ng maraming taon ng pagbuo kapag tuluyan na itong naging realidad. Ang Taj Mahal ay hindi itinayo sa loob lamang ng isang araw, at hindi rin ito ginawa para lamang humanga ang isang henerasyon. Itinayo ito sa antas ng craftsmanship na hindi maaaring balewalain sa loob ng maraming siglo. Ganoon din ang pilosopiyang ginamit sa pagbuo ng InterLink Chain. Hindi ito ang unang chain na inilunsad, at hindi rin ang pinakamalakas ang ingay, pero nang mailunsad ito sa testnet, tunay ang infrastructure at matatag ang pundasyon.

Live na ang unang dApp. Ginagawa na ang pangalawa. Nagsimula nang gumalaw ang ecosystem, at narito ka bago pa ito naging malinaw sa lahat.

#InterLink #ITLG #ITL #InterLinkActiveBounty3 #WorldCup2026

THE FIRST dApp HAS OFFICIALLY AND SUCCESSFULLY LAUNCHED ON INTERLINK TAJ MAHAL TESTNET. 🔥

This is not a demo. This is not a prototype. This is a real application, running on real infrastructure, on the InterLink Chain Taj Mahal Testnet right now.

Introducing BitFlip, a Bitcoin price prediction game that is fully on-chain and powered by InterLink Chain.

Every round begins with the chain recording the live BTC price. Players predict whether Bitcoin will be higher or lower 5 minutes from now, with 3 minutes open for bets and 2 minutes locked before settlement. Minimum stake is 0.01 $ITL, maximum is 10 $ITL. Predict correctly and you get your stake back with a 90% reward on top. Predict wrong and the stake is gone. No off-chain middleware, no centralized resolver, no manual intervention. Every round opens, locks, and settles directly on InterLink Chain.

For BitFlip to run correctly, the infrastructure had to be real. The RPC layer had to handle live round creation, bet submission, and on-chain settlement continuously within a 5-minute window, under real user load, with deterministic results every single time. No lag, no ambiguity, no room for error. It held.

BitFlip is proof that InterLink Chain's RPC infrastructure is not theoretical anymore. Developers connected, transactions processed, rounds resolved, and users played through every cycle without a single break in the system. Everything worked exactly as it was supposed to.
And what this testnet phase is beginning to reveal goes beyond one game. InterLink Chain is an app-chain model. Developers here are not constrained to deploying smart contracts on top of someone else's rules. Teams can build application-specific blockchains with full control over their own fee structure, tokenomics, validator sets, and governance design. Every application gets dedicated blockspace without competing for gas against unrelated traffic. Sovereignty is not a premium feature here. It is the starting point.

This is what years of building looks like when it finally touches reality. The Taj Mahal was not built in a day, and it was not built to impress a single generation. It was built with a standard of craftsmanship that made it impossible to ignore across centuries. InterLink Chain was built with that same philosophy. Not the first chain to launch, not the loudest in the room, but when it launched on testnet, the infrastructure was real and the foundation was solid.

The first dApp is live. The second is already being built. The ecosystem has started moving, and you were here before it was obvious to everyone else. 
#InterLink #ITLG #ITL

During Exercise BALIKATAN 41-26 in the Philippines, the Canadian Armed Forces participated as an active live fire participant in this large-scale multinational exercise involving more than 17,000 personnel from Australia, Japan, France, New Zealand, the Philippines, and Canada. 

HMCS Charlottetown and its CH-148 Cyclone helicopter, equipped with new and up to date gunnery, conducted key anti-submarine warfare operations and joint maritime strikes in the West Philippine Sea.

On land, soldiers from 3rd Battalion, Canadian Light Infantry (3 PPCLI) carried out intensive jungle warfare training before executing live-ammunition counter-landing exercises on the beaches of northern Luzon, where they employed infantry weapons including C7/C8 assault rifles, C9 machine guns, and other direct-fire arms in coordinated defensive fire alongside trusted allied forces. 

This deployment reflects Canada’s direct involvement in Indo-Pacific Strategy and a clear shift from a primarily peacekeeping posture to a more assertive and lethal presence alongside trusted allies who have consistently stood with Canada (for the most part). 

Through their performance across maritime, land, and multi-domain operations, Canadian personnel earned extremely strong respect from partner nations, demonstrating that the CAF remains a capable and determined force ready to defend Canada’s interests and sovereignty when called upon.

Canada Strong. 🇨🇦
